review_description: From the first contact with South Solar, I felt confident with that company, the quote was around the mark for a quality system & everything from the installation to all the paperwork was performed with professionalism. We are very pleased we chose South Solar.
Dave was very professional & was more than happy to go out of his way to make sure that I was pleased with the service that he provided.
The owner of the business responded quickly - corresponded over the weekend which is unusual and came out to quote quickly.He was just keener for the business than others.
Dave was knowledgable, straight talking and listened to our needs/desires.All questions were answered promptly with confidence.I would certainly recommend Solar South.

We found David a good honest salesman who did not try and sell us something we did not need.  He came out to quote and view our roof so he knew exactly what we were after and explained everything to us. We would recommend him to anyone. Very happy with the service. We have not had the system in long enough yet but hopefully we do not receive a power bill as such.

I contacted the three installers - two (2) got back to me, and the one I ended up with sent me detailed info and came out and checked everything.  It seems to me that the others only wanted to google my house and then give a quote on online.
